item.title: Colorful road asphalt makes traffic safer
item.description: New studies of American intersections show that colorful road art, combined with other safety measures, helps motorists drive more safely. Colorful crosswalks and bike lanes resulted in 32% fewer car accidents and 52% fewer accidents involving pedestrians and cyclists. One of the studies also found something striking about driver behavior.
